decisions.reason: As an inertial measurement sensor module close to the firm's existing modular sensing platform, it fits the firm's knowledge base well and its in-house R&D should make early market feedback actionable rather than a reason to exit.

The industrial AC voltage input module directly builds on the firm's established control and measurement offer, so with strong absorptive capacity and visible standalone presentation it is likely to be retained and improved.

A four-channel solid state relay module is closely related to the firm's automation and power competencies, making it a product the firm can readily support, learn from and integrate into its broader system.

The server room monitoring sensor kit still builds on the firm's established hardware-software building blocks, but as a somewhat more application-specific bundle it faces a slightly higher chance of withdrawal than the core modules despite the firm's strong R&D base.
